description: Diagnose a stale-memoization bug in one session; a fresh session applies the fix from the recorded analysis.

phases.instruction: The test suite in this package fails. Run `node --test`, then diagnose the root cause: which component is wrong, why the observed failure follows from the code, and what the minimal fix is. Record your findings in `DIAGNOSIS.md` in the project root — root cause first, then the evidence (the failing test and the code paths involved). Do not modify anything under `src/` or `test/` in this step; analysis only.
Fix the bug identified earlier so the full test suite passes (`node --test`). Your earlier analysis is in this workspace. Keep the change minimal and do not modify the test files.
